title: Get your WOOFi stake and vault back to your wallet
verified: Checked on 2026-10-28 with the author's own account: every screen on the official site, and for each transaction where it goes and what data it carries (using a read-only test wallet; nothing was actually sent). A real withdrawal test is still to come.
covers: WOO staked on Arbitrum, unclaimed rewards, and settled ETH waiting in a vault
summary: WOO staked on WOOFi (Arbitrum), USDC rewards you never claimed, money in the ETH vault that was settled but never collected: three taps on the official site, each one an ordinary transaction, and the money goes straight back to your wallet.
facts: 1–3 (depending on what you have). Ordinary transactions, no approvals
About 0.00002 ETH for all three, a few cents, paid from the ETH in your wallet on Arbitrum
About 5 minutes, no waiting for a settlement
At least 0.0002 ETH on Arbitrum in your wallet. Below that, the official site won't let you continue

support.label: WOOFi official Discord
support.note: The official channels listed at the bottom of WOOFi's site are Discord and X (@_WOOFi). WOOFi never DMs you first. Any "support" that DMs you is a scammer.

vars.eth: the ETH you can collect from the vault

pro: **Route**: woofi.com/stake → **Claim** the rewards → **Unstake** everything → **Earn** at the bottom → My vaults → the ETH card on Arbitrum → WITHDRAW tab → **WITHDRAW** next to Available for Withdrawals.
**Three transactions**: claimRewards to 0xa9E2…24Fb; unstake (all) to 0x2CFa…d8e2; withdraw to 0xE77A…Ad6a. All send 0 ETH, need no approval and no message signature.
**Your numbers**: claim {{usdc}} USDC, unstake {{woo}} WOO, collect {{eth}} ETH from the vault.
**Gotchas**: don't tap Compound or auto-compound. For the vault, tap the small WITHDRAW, not the big button. With less than 0.0002 ETH on Arbitrum, the official site won't let you continue.

done.where: on the Arbitrum network in your wallet
done.look: Where to look: your wallet app → Assets, with the network set to Arbitrum.

open.title: Open the official site in your wallet app
items: Open your wallet app (for example, Wallet in the Binance app) and make sure the selected wallet is the one that holds this money.
Use the wallet's DApp browser to open `https://woofi.com/stake`. Include https://, or it's treated as a search.
Check the address bar: the domain must be exactly **woofi.com**. One extra letter or a missing dot means stop.
✗ If a WE'RE SORRY message says your region isn't supported when you connect, stop here. This guide won't help you get around regional restrictions.

search-instead.see: Typing the address brings up search results
search-instead.do: Include `https://` and type the full address: `https://woofi.com/stake`.

restricted.see: A WE'RE SORRY message says your region isn't supported
restricted.do: Stop here. WOOFi doesn't serve your region, and this guide won't help you get around regional restrictions. You can ask in WOOFi's official Discord (see below).

not-sure.see: Not sure this is the official site
not-sure.do: Look at the address bar: the domain must be exactly **woofi.com**. If it isn't, close the page and type the address yourself. Don't tap links other people send you.

old-domain.do: That's WOOFi's old address and it now redirects to woofi.com. Go by what the address bar ends up showing: woofi.com.

connect.title: Connect your wallet and switch to Arbitrum
connect.note: Just connecting. No signature, no money moves
images: ① Tap **Connect Wallet** (the one at the top right works too)

① Pick **Detected Wallet**: that's the wallet in the app you're using right now ② In the Binance app, **Binance** works too. When your wallet asks to connect and the request comes from woofi.com, tap Connect
① Your address shows at the top right (hidden in the screenshot). It should be {{addrShort}} ② This icon is the current network. Tap it
① Pick **Arbitrum** and confirm the network switch in your wallet. If it's already Arbitrum (a small dot after the name), close the menu with the × at the top right

no-popup.see: Tapped Connect Wallet, but the wallet didn't ask to connect
no-popup.do: Open the page inside your wallet app's own DApp browser (step 1). If Detected Wallet does nothing, reopen the page and try Binance.

wrong-address.see: The address at the top right isn't the one with the money
wrong-address.do: Switch to the wallet that holds this money in your wallet app, then connect again. Don't continue if the address doesn't match.

sign-on-connect.see: Your wallet asks you to sign a message while connecting
sign-on-connect.do: Tap Reject, close the page and check the address again. WOOFi doesn't need a signature to connect (its site code makes no signature request).

wrong-network.see: The page says Wrong Network at the top
wrong-network.do: Tap the network icon at the top right, pick **Arbitrum** and confirm the switch in your wallet.

blocked-address.do: WOOFi blocked this address based on a sanctions list. This guide can't help.

claim.title: Claim your rewards
claim.whenText: Only needed if you have unclaimed rewards
images: ① Tap **Claim** (USDC reward above is what you haven't claimed. It's hidden in the screenshot and should be about {{usdc}}) ✗ Don't tap Compound: it turns the rewards into WOO and stakes them again, the opposite of what you want

check.title: Before you confirm, check 3 things
check.lead: After you tap Claim, your wallet asks you to confirm a transaction. Check it against this list and tap each item once it matches.
check.skip: Already claimed (USDC reward is 0)? Skip this step

confirm.title: The request comes from woofi.com, on Arbitrum
confirm.sub: One extra letter or a missing dot means stop

confirm.title: It goes to 0xa9E2…24Fb (WOOFi's staking contract)
confirm.sub: Look at the contract / To line. The first 6 and last 4 characters must match

confirm.title: It sends 0, plus a small fee (about 0.000006 ETH)
confirm.sub: This sends your rewards to you. You don't pay any tokens

reject: It asks you to send tokens, or the amount isn't 0
It asks you to sign a message (Sign)
normal: Your wallet may show "contract interaction" or claimRewards
The fee comes out of your ETH on Arbitrum, usually less than a cent
Your wallet may warn that this is a contract interaction. If the site and the address both match, it's fine to continue

cancelled.see: The page shows Cancelled · User denied transaction signature
cancelled.do: You tapped Reject in your wallet, so nothing moved. Check again, then tap Claim once more.

insufficient-gas.do: The official site needs at least 0.0002 ETH on Arbitrum in your wallet. Send a little ETH to this wallet on Arbitrum first (0.0005 is plenty), then come back.

compound-clicked.do: Your rewards were turned into WOO and added to your stake. Nothing is lost: they come out with the rest when you unstake in the next step.

auto-compound.do: Auto-compound is on. While it's on you can't claim, and it can't be turned off for 7 days after you turn it on. Tap Stuck? at the top right to see your situation. If you're unsure, ask in WOOFi's official Discord.

wrong-to.see: The request goes to an address other than 0xa9E2…24Fb

unstake.title: Unstake your WOO
unstake.whenText: Only needed if you have staked WOO
images: ① Tap **Unstake** ② Tap the number on the right of the input (all of your staked WOO, hidden in the screenshot). It fills in the full amount
① With the amount filled in (it should be {{woo}}), tap **UNSTAKE**

① In Unstake Confirmation, check the amount and tap **UNSTAKE**. Your wallet asks you to confirm a transaction: check it against the card below ! It says your XP (points) will be removed. XP can't be traded and doesn't affect the money you get back

check.title: Before you confirm, check 3 things
check.lead: After you tap UNSTAKE, your wallet asks you to confirm a transaction. Check it against this list and tap each item once it matches.
check.skip: No staked WOO? Skip this step

confirm.title: The request comes from woofi.com, on Arbitrum
confirm.sub: One extra letter or a missing dot means stop

confirm.title: It goes to 0x2CFa…d8e2 (WOOFi's staking contract)
confirm.sub: It's a different address from the claim step. That's normal

confirm.title: It sends 0, plus a small fee (about 0.000008 ETH)
confirm.sub: Your WOO comes back to you from the contract. You don't pay any tokens

reject: It asks you to send tokens, or the amount isn't 0
It asks you to sign a message (Sign)
normal: Your wallet may show "contract interaction" or unstake
Unstaking has no lock-up period and no fee

amount-not-full.do: Tap the number on the right of the input to fill in the full amount. Typing it yourself tends to leave some behind.

insufficient-balance.do: The amount is more than you have staked. Tap the number on the right of the input to fill it in again.

xp.see: The confirmation says your XP will be removed
xp.do: XP is WOOFi's points system. It can't be traded, and losing it doesn't affect the money you get back.

cancelled.see: The page shows Cancelled · User denied transaction signature
cancelled.do: You tapped Reject in your wallet, so nothing moved. Check again, then tap UNSTAKE once more.

wrong-to.see: The request goes to an address other than 0x2CFa…d8e2

vault.title: Collect the ETH from the vault
vault.whenText: Only needed if settled money is waiting for you in the ETH vault
images: ① Tap **Earn** at the bottom ② Tap **My vaults** (only vaults you've used) ③ Tap the **ETH** card on Arbitrum (My Deposits is your number, hidden in the screenshot)
① When the card opens, tap the **WITHDRAW** tab
① Scroll down to Available for Withdrawals (what you can collect, hidden in the screenshot, about {{eth}} ETH) and tap **WITHDRAW** next to it ✗ You don't need UNSTAKE or REQUEST WITHDRAWAL above it
items: ! Settled money isn't sent to your wallet automatically. You have to tap this yourself, and this is the step many people miss.

check.title: Before you confirm, check 3 things
check.lead: After you tap WITHDRAW, your wallet asks you to confirm a transaction. Check it against this list and tap each item once it matches.
check.skip: Nothing waiting in the vault? Skip this step

confirm.title: The request comes from woofi.com, on Arbitrum
confirm.sub: One extra letter or a missing dot means stop

confirm.title: It goes to 0xE77A…Ad6a (WOOFi's vault withdrawal contract)
confirm.sub: Each of the three steps uses a different address. That's normal

confirm.title: It sends 0, plus a small fee (about 0.000002 ETH)
confirm.sub: What comes out is ETH, straight back to your wallet

reject: It asks you to send tokens, or the amount isn't 0
It asks you to sign a message (Sign)
normal: Your wallet may show "contract interaction" or withdraw
You receive native ETH, not WETH

no-available.do: Either it's already been collected or it hasn't settled yet. Tap Stuck? at the top right for a live check.

big-button.see: The big REQUEST WITHDRAWAL button can't be tapped
big-button.do: That's expected: you don't need it. Tap the small **WITHDRAW** to the right of Available for Withdrawals.

shares-left.see: My Deposits is more than Available for Withdrawals
shares-left.do: Some of your money in the vault hasn't been requested yet. For now this guide only covers settled money waiting to be collected. For the rest, use Instant Withdraw on the WITHDRAW tab (arrives right away, 1% fee) or REQUEST WITHDRAWAL (free, but you wait until next Tuesday).

cancelled.see: The page shows Cancelled · User denied transaction signature
cancelled.do: You tapped Reject in your wallet, so nothing moved. Check again, then tap WITHDRAW once more.

wrong-to.see: The request goes to an address other than 0xE77A…Ad6a

check.title: Check that it arrived
rows: A few seconds after each transaction confirms
Your wallet app → Assets, with the network set to Arbitrum
About {{woo}} WOO, {{usdc}} USDC and {{eth}} ETH more (whichever of these you had)
WOO comes from WOOFi's staking contract 0x2CFa…d8e2, USDC from WOOFi's reward contract, ETH from WOOFi's vault withdrawal contract 0xE77A…Ad6a. Your address receives all of them
Tap Stuck? at the top right for a live check. If the transaction succeeded but you can't see the WOO, add the token in your wallet
check.foot: Once it arrives, you're done. WOO is an ordinary token: keep it or swap it in your wallet

no-woo.see: Can't see WOO in the wallet
no-woo.do: Some wallets don't show new tokens on their own. Search for WOO (Arbitrum) in your wallet, or add it with the contract address `0xcafcd85d8ca7ad1e1c6f82f651fa15e33aefd07b`.

eth-not-weth.see: What arrived is ETH, not WETH
eth-not-weth.do: That's normal: the vault withdrawal contract unwraps WETH and sends you native ETH.

want-usdc.see: Want to swap the WOO for USDC
want-usdc.do: The WOO is already in your own wallet, so you can use your wallet's built-in swap. This guide doesn't cover swapping. Check the quote and slippage before you swap.
